draft_payload_json.title: Pediatric Hypertension and Diabetes (Age 2-17)
draft_payload_json.rationale: Existing local cohort definition matched the reviewed study intent.
draft_payload_json.description: All patients aged 2-17 in the Acumenus CDM with a diagnosis of hypertension (essential, secondary, hypertensive heart/renal disease, prehypertension) OR diabetes mellitus (Type 1, Type 2, MODY, neonatal, CF-related, mitochondrial) OR metabolic precursors (prediabetes, impaired glucose tolerance/fasting glycemia, hyperglycemia, insulin resistance, metabolic syndrome). Comprehensive obstetric/gestational exclusions applied to both concept sets. Based on AAP 2017 CPG for pediatric HTN and ADA Standards of Care for pediatric DM. Uses concept sets: Pediatric Hypertension (#148, 13 items) and Pediatric Diabetes and Metabolic Precursors (#149, 26 items).
